[[File:Jeffrey Adams (mathematician) 1983 (headshot).jpg|thumb|right|Jeffrey Adams in 1983]]
'''Jeffrey David Adams''' (born 1956) is a mathematician at the [[University of Maryland, College Park|University of Maryland]] who works on [[unitary representation]]s of reductive [[Lie group]]s and who led the project ''[[Atlas of Lie groups and representations|Atlas of Lie Groups and Representations]]'' that calculated the characters of the representations of [[E8 (mathematics)|E<sub>8</sub>]].<ref name=Webwire>{{Cite news|title= American Institute of Mathematics Announces Mathematicians Solve E8 |url=http://www.webwire.com/ViewPressRel.asp?aId=29907 |publisher=Webwire |date=19 March 2007 |access-date=19 July 2009 }}<!-- typo of "Mathmeticians" is in original title --></ref><ref name="The Age">{{Cite news|title=E8 + 248 = happy mathematicians |url=http://www.theage.com.au/news/world/e8--248--happy-mathematicians/2007/03/19/1174152970807.html |work=The Age |date=20 March 2007 |access-date=19 July 2009 }}</ref> The project to calculate the representations of E<sub>8</sub> has been compared to the [[Human Genome Project]] in scope.<ref name=Webwire/><ref name="The Age"/> Together with [[Dan Barbasch]] and [[David Vogan]], he co-authored a monograph on a geometric approach to the [[Langlands classification]] and [[Arthur's conjectures]] in the real case.

He completed his Ph.D. at Yale University under the supervision of [[Gregg Zuckerman]] in 1981.
In 2012, he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=25 August 2018 }}, retrieved 2012-11-03.</ref>
